description: Opening the login page on Safari 17 throws a null-reference error in the auth bundle and the tab becomes unresponsive. Reproduced on macOS Sonoma and iOS 17.
title: Login page crashes on Safari 17

description: Applying a percentage coupon at checkout rounds the total down by one cent compared to the receipt. Finance flagged a mismatch in the daily reconciliation report.
title: Checkout total off by one cent when coupon applied

description: The footer reads 'Copright 2026' instead of 'Copyright 2026' on the marketing site. Cosmetic only, no functional impact.
title: Typo in footer copyright text

description: If the mobile app is backgrounded mid-upload, the queued file is dropped silently and the upload never retries. Three enterprise customers reported lost attachments this week.
title: Data loss when app is backgrounded during upload

description: Toggling dark mode on the settings page flashes the light theme for ~300ms before applying. Annoying but the setting itself persists correctly.
title: Dark mode toggle flickers on settings page
